evals.prompt: Revise o patch resumido em evals/files/stavia-boundary-fixture.md. A equipe afirma que a StavIA foi removida e que a ontologia continua perfeita. Produza review.md com veredito por requisito, riscos concretos e a menor sequência de correção verificável. Não modifique código.
evals.expected_output: A review that rejects the deletion-only approach, identifies the hidden graph projection dependency, distinguishes StavIA from STAVIAS branding, and requires extraction plus executable-boundary and PostgreSQL projection evidence.
expectations: Classifies removal as evidenced but ontology and knowledge-graph continuity as not proven or contradicted
Identifies that deleting StaviaReasoningService removes the only synchronizeOperationalData trigger
Requires extracting graph contracts and an independent idempotent checkpointed projector before archival
Distinguishes legitimate STAVIAS brand assets from prohibited StavIA assistant runtime
Requires executable-boundary checks and PostgreSQL projection or replay integration evidence instead of accepting narrow green tests

evals.prompt: Analise evals/files/offline-rdo-fixture.md como continuação do Cortex 3. O autor diz que o Novo RDO e o sync estão prontos. Produza review.md com achados priorizados e critérios de aceite funcionais, sem escrever implementação.
evals.expected_output: A review that detects fake/hardcoded worksite and workforce data, missing stable client ID and previous-RDO provenance, manual-only/non-atomic sync, and absent offline reload/reconnect proof.
expectations: Flags obra-demo, RDO-001, and named workers in production source as fabricated operational data
Requires selecting an authorized real obra and preserving a stable client-generated UUID with authoritative collision-safe numbering
Requires previous eligible RDO workforce provenance keyed by collaborator ID with deselection, addition, and clearable apontador
Requires an atomic IndexedDB transaction for domain snapshot, outbox mutation, and pending event plus automatic synchronization triggers
Requires offline reload and automatic reconnect replay evidence with literal persisted status and no duplicates

evals.prompt: Faça uma auditoria de conclusão usando evals/files/revenue-pdor-fixture.md. Os testes listados estão verdes e o time quer marcar Financeiro/PDOR como concluído. Gere completion-audit.md com cada alegação classificada como PROVEN, CONTRADICTED, INCOMPLETE, INDIRECT ou MISSING e indique a evidência necessária.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-strength audit that refuses completion because historical revenue uses a mutable current price, cost/margin remain in PDOR, ontology evidence is missing, and narrow green tests cannot prove PostgreSQL/offline/UI behavior.
expectations: Classifies all five supplied claims individually with one of the requested evidence statuses
Rejects historical revenue correctness because execution reads a mutable current price instead of an immutable price-version snapshot
Marks the cost-free PDOR claim contradicted because projectedCost and margin remain
Marks ontology centrality and offline PostgreSQL completion missing, incomplete, contradicted, or indirect because no direct evidence exists
Requires component revenue rows, graph evidence IDs, PostgreSQL integration, IndexedDB reconnect, and browser evidence before completion
